import re

# Parse each file and reorganize
for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Pattern: date__name.ext
    match = re.match(r'^(.+?)__(.+?)\.([^.]+)$', filename)
    if not match:
        print(f"Skipping {filename}: pattern not matched")
        continue
    date_str = match.group(1)
    name = match.group(2)
    ext = match.group(3)
    # Destination directory: ~/documents/work/meetings_files/<name>/
    dest_dir = f"~/documents/work/meetings_files/{name}/"
    # Create directory if not exists
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dest_dir, recursive=True)
    # Destination file path
    dest_file = f"{dest_dir}{date_str}.{ext}"
    # Move file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(
        access_token=fs_token,
        source_file_path=file_path,
        destination_file_path=dest_file,
        overwrite=False,
        retain_dates=True
    )
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_file}: {result}")
